title: S01 Fixed Entryway Floor Mirror
description: Original S01 fixed full-length entryway mirror, width 0.64 m, depth 0.34 m and height 1.68 m. A continuous 60 mm-deep clipped-corner maple ring retains a separate 7 mm mirror sheet and an 18 mm seafoam backboard. Two fixed rear supports join the lower ring and backboard to a broad ivory floor base. Metres, Z up, front -Y, origin at the floor-contact centre. Six named closed independently editable static components. The mirror uses standard metallic-roughness PBR, metallic 1 and roughness 0.12; no runtime planar reflection, environment capture or reflection-fidelity guarantee. No pivot, animation, decorative props, wall installation, load, stability, glass-safety or manufacturing certification.
